## `mypackage.run(path, *, verbose=False)`

Run the main task on the file at `path`.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `path` | `str` | Input file |
| `verbose` | `bool` | Print progress |

Returns a `Result` object.

## Configuration

Settings are read from `mypackage.toml` in the working directory.

```{.toml filename="mypackage.toml"}
[run]
delay = 30
```
